output.postmortem: Timeline: Incident began at 2026-08-29T16:32:10Z and was auto-remediated. Root Cause: Failure class F07: Client-side impression beacons for the 'roku' device class were not being successfully collected in the 'eu' region. Evidence: A high impression gap of 77.5% was isolated to the 'roku' device class. Upstream ad delivery metrics, including ad fill ratio (87.5%) and CDN health (0% 5xx errors), were confirmed to be healthy, ruling out delivery or ad decisioning failures. Action Taken: Runbook 'rb-beacon-fallback' was executed automatically. A configuration patch was sent via POST to 'ssai/admin/beacon-mode' to switch the 'roku' device class to 'server_side' beaconing. Verification: The action was successful. The impression gap for the affected device class was reduced from 77.5% to a residual gap of 4.2%, confirming recovery.
